summary: Require measured first-use installation and interrupted package/model acquisition recovery before selecting a lower-cost route for an explicit starting-state and ownership scenario.
rationale: UBU-D0332 and UBU-D0337 already require setup costs, entry-cash limits and secure local operation, but prepared inference trials do not demonstrate that users can obtain and install the required packages within those budgets. One setup trial and one acquisition-recovery trial expose transferred data, helper resources, effort and temporary storage without inventing prices or supported hardware. Keep UBU-Q0178 Open until comparative real-device evidence supports an operator-approved selection.

+## UBU-D0363: Lower-cost paths require first-use setup and acquisition-recovery evidence
+
+**Status:** Accepted → DESIGN.md §1. Narrows `UBU-Q0178`; measured lower-cost selection remains Open.
+
+Extend `UBU-D0332`/`UBU-D0337` with one first-use setup trial and one interrupted package/model acquisition followed by recovery for each eligible candidate route on its exact hardware. Freeze the starting inventory, installation path, connectivity/data allowance, required helper resources and finite data, elapsed-time and active-effort limits. Measure through the first useful camera-and-voice outcome under the existing frozen rubric. Keep already-installed and packages/models-absent starting states distinct; a prepared inference trial cannot establish access from absent packages.
+
+Report all transferred bytes and retries, operator/helper effort, energy and peak download/unpacking/installation/recovery storage. Apply existing installation/model-integrity gates before activation. Include helper and connectivity costs in the applicable entry/period totals; show recovery cost separately and disclose its assumed frequency and uncertainty in period estimates. Publish setup-limit results and evidence in the existing cost/support matrix; failed or unknown required setup limits prevent selection for the affected starting-state/ownership scenario.
+
+This adds evidence for the existing setup-cost obligation, not a provisioning or maintenance-automation architecture, passing result, price or selected configuration. Preserve `UBU-D0331`/`UBU-D0336`, useful-outcome accounting and the explicit no-worker gap. `UBU-Q0178` remains Open pending operator-reviewed comparative results.
+

 ## UBU-Q0178: Economically accessible local compute paths
 
 Status: Open Priority: MVP important Phase: Phase 2 Decision type: Product Auto-choice eligibility: Human approval required Importance score: TBD Automation-likelihood score: TBD Risk score: TBD Answerability score: 100 Depends on: None Blocks: None Resolved by: None Last scored: 2026-10-14 Scored from commit: None
 
 ### Question
 
 Which lower-cost local compute paths prevent economically precarious users from being excluded from the multimodal experience?
 
 ### Current direction
 
 Delta §17.16. Consider smaller local models, bounded snapshots, CPU fallback, reduced latency classes and operator-controlled trusted hardware without a hidden hosted-model dependency. Measure the useful tradeoffs before claiming reach or costs. Compute accessibility is part of the mission, not a promised device minimum.
 
-`UBU-D0332` specifies a comparison of bounded CPU-capable single-Device inference and an existing personal worker, with whole-route cost/effort budgets and the qualification gates in DESIGN.md §1. Actual useful lower-cost profiles and cost envelopes remain unselected. `UBU-D0337` adds explicit ownership scenarios, entry/period cash limits and all-attempt accounting per useful multimodal outcome; the no-worker scenario and any remaining gap must stay visible.
+`UBU-D0332` specifies a comparison of bounded CPU-capable single-Device inference and an existing personal worker, with whole-route cost/effort budgets and the qualification gates in DESIGN.md §1. Actual useful lower-cost profiles and cost envelopes remain unselected. `UBU-D0337` adds explicit ownership scenarios, entry/period cash limits and all-attempt accounting per useful multimodal outcome; the no-worker scenario and any remaining gap must stay visible. `UBU-D0363` adds first-use setup and interrupted package/model acquisition trials, accounting for transferred data, helper resources and peak installation/recovery storage by starting-state/ownership scenario.
 
 ### Resolution
 
-Open. `UBU-D0332` answers the candidate-path and cost-evidence contract; `UBU-D0337` adds entry/period cash and useful-outcome accounting only. Close after operator-reviewed comparative real-device results select at least one qualified lower-cost camera-and-voice path for explicit ownership scenarios within declared entry, period and total cash, effort, energy and storage budgets, with useful end-to-end outcomes and mandatory security/retention gates met. Keep unqualified ownership scenarios and any no-worker gap explicit. A protocol, smaller model or text-only fallback cannot establish economically accessible multimodal reach.
+Open. `UBU-D0332` answers the candidate-path and cost-evidence contract; `UBU-D0337` adds entry/period cash and useful-outcome accounting only. `UBU-D0363` adds setup and acquisition-recovery evidence; no measured path is selected. Close after operator-reviewed comparative real-device results select at least one qualified lower-cost camera-and-voice path for explicit ownership scenarios within declared entry, period and total cash, effort, energy and storage budgets, with useful end-to-end outcomes and mandatory security/retention gates met. Keep unqualified ownership scenarios and any no-worker gap explicit. A protocol, smaller model or text-only fallback cannot establish economically accessible multimodal reach.
